research_question: At fixed selective outputs, can production cross-file discovery combined with native HDF5 reading beat native scanning or a general native metadata index as N and stored V grow?
hypotheses: Repeated native per-file HDF5 metadata opens and attribute reads dominate unindexed discovery as N grows.
A general persistent FS index may already eliminate that bottleneck and remain faster than IoTDB-FS.
Native HDF5 after production discovery reduces typed materialization/IPC costs, but may not remove discovery/admission costs.
Stored V can increase owner snapshot work even when Latest or a bounded historical window fixes output size.
version_selection: one interior published round using actual Between timestamp fence
two interior published rounds using actual Between timestamp fence; N <=512
FS_scan_scope: General version catalog prunes caller timestamp range before native HDF5 metadata inspection; no forced all-history scan or oracle-selected filenames
FS_index_scope: One general SQLite catalog per immutable N/V snapshot, prepared queries, predicate/version/latest indexes, matched source stat validation, native HDF5 hyperslabs

production.binary: frozen ordinary V04 r3, HDF5 implementation unchanged by the subsequent GRIB cache fix

publication: Real ordinary FUSE write/fsync/close; round-major; actual per-file physical versions recorded; empty O_TRUNC snapshots retained; source SHA independently verified; no metadata-only clone
FS_history: Full allocated independent regular version files; no sparse files, hardlinks or reflinks; same immutable files serve as ingestion input and FS/native-local baseline
arm_order: Rotate five arms across five temporal campaigns
first_observation: repeat0 per group/campaign retained separately; not claimed cold; contexts and OS caches can remain warm
timing: Complete client-owned Float32 values and uint8 validity arrays; includes actual discovery and read/transport/copy path; profile waits and independent oracle hashing excluded for all arms
pipeline_scope: Equivalent observable owned outputs, different real pipelines: native ctypes writes into client-owned arrays, typed path includes server IPC and owned client copy
separate_costs: general version catalog and native index construction
interpretation: Report all arms and campaigns, absolute latency, increments and ratios; no pooled-repeat significance claim or winner-only selection; a win over FS-scan alone does not establish superiority over FS-index

pilot.role: Functional five-path/ROI/oracle and actual preparation-cost validation, not a scale-performance conclusion

service: Authorized original database, shared existing account and unchanged license; original SYNC control window restored in finally; no isolated instance or new activation

original_approved_scope.supplement_versions: Latest and one-round historical window only; select largest feasible stored V under real preparation costs and unchanged limits

native_FS_only_cases.source_cap_interpretation: Native FS-only mechanism point outside production1024source cap; not compared as an executable supported IoTDB query
